decision.summary: A correlated multi-sample drop in N/E/U begins around index 515, with N and E decreasing together over ~5 samples and U showing a sharper, shorter dip. U recovers by index 522, but N/E remain offset through the end of the allowed context (560), with no observed return. The candidate jump at 524 is inconsistent with the direction of N/E motion (N continues decreasing, E increases slightly but not to pre-drop level), and does not mark a reversal. Without a confirmed opposing edge on N/E, the interval is classified as uncertain.

intervals.observation: N and E show a multi-sample drop starting ~515, with N decreasing from ~0.36 to -1.96 (index 515→520) and E from ~2.22 to ~0.74; U dips sharply from ~1.55 to ~-0.19 at index 520 then rebounds by 522, while N/E remain depressed through 524. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 560), and no clear opposing edge on N/E before 560. Asymmetric recovery suggests superposed transient + offset; status uncertain.
